name: ado
description: Azure DevOps through its own program `ado`: work items (read, history, links, attachments, saved queries; comment, update, tags, create, link, attach), pipeline runs (the stage, job and task tree, why a run failed, logs, test results, changes; queue, cancel, retry) and classic releases (deploy). Reads run; a write, a pipeline run or a deployment waits for the person's approval on the task page (a write goes through for the items the task is linked to when the person opened them).
